name: 10pines-c2-elevator-console
title: Elevator status console (Observer)
description: A finished State-based elevator controller must notify two given views (a text console that logs 'Puerta Cerrandose', 'Cabina Moviendose', etc., and a status view with cabin/door field models) of every cabin and door state change, without the elevator knowing its views. The student must add the Observer mechanism (the course suggests 'active variables') so the 4 ElevatorViewTest tests pass while the 25 elevator tests keep passing.
source: 10Pines-Capacitacion/C2 - Diseño Avanzado de Software con Objetos II

design.notes: The interesting decision is where the notification lives: the reference solution reifies the two state variables as ActiveVariable objects (observable and polymorphic with their subject through doesNotUnderstand:), so the seven transition methods change from assignment to a message and the views dispatch on the new state with the already given visitor protocol; a student may instead notify from each transition method or add an observer list to Elevator.
